exact_lowering_cause.effect: F45 clones the task kernel region into func.func @__task_profile__. A void kernel gets a synthetic i1 result; each neura.yield becomes arith.constant true plus func.return of that value. F45 then reruns its full mapper-lowering pipeline on the wrapper before mapping.

The extracted function takes the function path, which calls GrantPredicateInEntryBlock with the default has_task_counter=false. That pass adds grant_once for every predicated entry-block live-out passed through a branch. The kernel path instead passes taskHasCounter(kernel); a task counter suppresses those grants. The eight added grant_once nodes are visible at AMOEBA DFG lines 4-6, 9, 12, 17, 21, 27.

F45 promote-input-arg-to-const and fold-constant leave one explicit constant versus ORBIT's three input constants. This accounts for the minus-two neura.constant delta; it offsets two of the extra PE-consuming nodes.
The dummy returned trigger creates the extra merge phi and neura.return_value; its true/false control arms create two more grant_predicate nodes.

ORBIT builds a void __joint_task_mapper_replay__ wrapper from the already-lowered kernel yield contract, adds no dummy result, and maps after InsertDataMov only. It does not rerun F45's return/live-in/control-to-dataflow lowering.

crossed_mapper_replay.conclusion: The measured II delta follows the pre-mapper graph, unchanged under compiler exchange. This crossed result establishes the cause for Harris Task_1; the diagnostic notes surrounding mapper resource/route code differs and does not generalize the equality to all kernels.

This leaves Task_18 and Task_20 starts 3484 cycles later; Task_20's 2-cycle startup delta gives the final 3486. The two Task_16 adjacent route-offset changes cancel.

controlled_comparison_proposal.canonical_input: Prepare one full Taskflow/Neura module with the ORBIT source-domain pipeline; use that byte-identical module for both decision arms.
controlled_comparison_proposal.common_mapper_pin: Use the same ORBIT MapJoint mapper frontend, binary, architecture, exact wrapper cache, and mapping cache to produce all per-task/per-shape profiles. Record compiled II, max mapping time_step+1, materialized operation count, common static trip count, and common startup/duration.

f45_profile_import.required_root_and_coverage: function name and a profiles array for every matching task name
f45_profile_import.profile_constraints: All integer cost/count fields must be positive; mapper_succeeded must be true. The loader does not verify a DFG, mapper, architecture, or body identity and does not recompute estimated_latency from II/trips/steps.
f45_profile_import.common_cost_encoding: Set estimated_latency to the shared integer duration from the common C++ cost adapter (common startup + common II*(trip_count-1)); set steps from the common mapper's max time_step+1. F45 uses estimated_latency as the assignment cost.

controlled_comparison_proposal.orbit_profile_contract: MapJointSchedulingTasksPass has no equivalent task-profile JSON override. Score JSONL can carry startup_cycles and predicted_ii, but MapJoint still maps the kernel body; it records prediction equality rather than rejecting a mismatch. Pin the mapper and require equality for every task.

choice_replay.source_owned_shape_import: Use --enumerate-analytical-task-candidates followed by --materialize-analytical-task-candidate on the common canonical module. The materializer validates task order, static trip counts, architecture, and legal oriented rectangles, then writes shape attributes without profiling or mapper calls.
choice_replay.all_unit_radar_example: scripts/run_input0_all_unit_baselines.py:172-185 shows factored enumeration with max-cgras-per-task=1, candidate-0 materialization, MapJoint, and native scheduling. This replays Radar's F45 1x1/r1 resource choice without F45 body-equivalence or original-decision provenance assumptions.
choice_replay.mixed_shapes: Materialize a complete factored candidate ID matching the F45 per-task shapes; then MapJoint the current common canonical bodies. For replica counts above one, use a source-owned replica materializer and one shared replica-duration policy; the shape-candidate pass alone does not encode aggregate replica choices.
choice_replay.harris_task1_fixture: Use diagnostics/neura-mapper-input-comparison-20261005/replay_comparison.py with the two checked-in pre-mapper task graphs to rerun the exact 2x2 crossed mapper control. For a full scheduler control, include Task_1 in the common canonical Taskflow module and generate its common profile row there.

controlled_comparison_proposal.algorithm_variable: Keep the common mapper/profile/trip/startup/dependency inputs fixed, then change only the allocator/scheduler decision algorithm. Evaluate resulting resource choices through the same ORBIT production scheduler and explicit network when comparing final makespan.
controlled_comparison_proposal.contract_obstacle: F45 TaskScheduler consumes Taskflow dependencies and per-task estimated latency but has no explicit routed inter-task network input; its internal objective is pipeline_interval. Thus F45's internal objective remains an algorithm variable. Final makespan must be reevaluated through the shared ORBIT production scheduler to apply the common network. The F45 profile JSON is name-bound only, so the harness should record the common canonical and mapper pin alongside it and assert per-task II equality.

harris_held_s2_convolution_tiling.treatment: explicit axis-0 factor-8 output tiling on Task_2, then Tasks_2/3/4; all other S2 resources held

summed_task_execution_duration_cycles.interpretation: The end-to-end reductions do not come from lower aggregate PE execution duration; the tiled totals are +14 and +49 cycles. The gain comes from earlier production/transfer overlap on the limiting dependency chain.

task5_release_and_t9_start.interpretation: Task_5 duration and its 1,048,576-bit Task_5->Task_9 transfer remain effectively unchanged; route latency drops by one cycle (2 to 1). Earlier tiled producer shards release Task_5 75,979 cycles earlier; the unchanged critical suffix then moves Task_9 and the final makespan 75,980 cycles earlier.

noncritical_t4_to_t6.interpretation: Tiling makes this branch much earlier, but Task_5->Task_9 remains the makespan-limiting branch.

incomplete_input_region_fanout_evidence.interpretation: Task_2 output tiling is materialized, but the trace retains a full 1,048,576-bit input edge from each source replica to every child. The source/task module has no per-shard input-region proof for these reads; observed routed input volume therefore expands eightfold. This establishes what the current trace models and supports incomplete input-region tiling; it does not by itself claim an eightfold physical DRAM read.

qkv_eightway_group_search_evidence.graph_topology: Task_0 and Task_1 are incomparable producers feeding each Task_3 replica; Task_2 feeds Task_6. These three roots converge transitively at Task_6.
qkv_eightway_group_search_evidence.gap: The action generator emits per-task tile primitives and direct-edge producer/consumer co-tiling at factor 2; it has no atomic grouped tiling primitive for a bounded set of incomparable producers that converge at one join. The exact beneficial three-action combination is not an existing single action; a sequential path may be pruned before reaching it.
qkv_eightway_group_search_evidence.workload_independent_recommendation: Add a bounded source-owned action family enumerating deterministic groups of 2-4 pairwise incomparable SSA/task producers in one dependency cone with a common consumer/join (direct or a small bounded ancestor-to-join distance), each group using one axis and factor from supported partition factors. Store sorted group primitives in one NeighborhoodAction, deduplicate canonical labels, and let the existing materializer remain the fail-closed legality proof. This is a search recommendation, not a confirmed winner or production-ready candidate.
